hints.title: Sequential Temporal Generation
hints.text: Yield formatted calendar dates incrementally until advancing past the boundary threshold.

hints.title: Date Arithmetic Tracking
hints.text: Parse strings into calendar date objects and advance the day component by step on each cycle.

hints.title: Generator Step Advancement
hints.text: While current date does not exceed end date, yield toISOString() slice (0, 10), then increment date via setDate(getDate() + step).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of generated dates in range
complexity.notes: Yields dates lazily with constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Manual calendar calculation without Date object fails across leap years and month length variations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lazy generation avoids allocating intermediate date arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of Date.prototype.setDate for automatic month and year rollover handling.
